answer: Make every identity a vertex that must keep proving it is alive: each epoch a random audit draws a few vertices and re-checks one past answer against fresh data, like an orchard keeper inspecting a random tree each season while the dune shifts the sample so no fake can predict which record will be tested. An honest agent simply keeps its real history. An attacker with a thousand fakes must fabricate a thousand complete, checkable histories and keep every one consistent under random audits, so each fake costs the full price and the flood fails.
